show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/yvy7BY
show.description: The show “Supreme Sister ” follows Isha, an adopted daughter mistreated and framed by her envious sister Riddhi, who manipulates the Arora family into believing Isha is a thief. Wronged and cast out, Isha gets a second chance at life, where she vows to fight back, reclaim her dignity, and rise above betrayal to build her own identity
